message:
I have sat here and read everyone of the complaints and have to agree that Evercom/T-Netix (which now are going by Securus) are really a ripoff.

I worked for Evercom for 8 years and when I stood up and started telling the upper management that what was going on with the cost of the calls was totally wrong I was asked to leave the company or I would be fired.  Well anyway, I left the company after thinking very hard about it for a few days.

I hope that everyone that has posted here understands that when Securus gets the contracts with the DOC or the County Jails that the State tells Securus how much that they can charge for the collect or pre-pay calls.  So I keep seeing that everyone is pissed off at Securus but you should also be pointing that anger back at the State also for they are getting a cut of the money that Securus is getting from you.   I know that there are a few states that are getting somewhere around 50% of the money is being collected for the calls.

Just wanted to let everyone know of this so that maybe we can stand up to  Securus and the State Goverments and tell them that something really needs to be done about this.

GOOD LUCK TO EVERYONE!!!
